name: Crisis Action
summary:
Crisis Action is a mobile first-person shooter featuring multiple game modes including tactical combat, ranked matches, mech battles, PvE challenges, parkour with zombies, and a paint-based territory control mode. Players can also engage in gravity-free combat, hide-and-seek, and team or solo arena matches.

The game supports both competitive ranked play across seasons and casual entertainment modes. It is free-to-play with optional in-game purchases.
